free_1h.name: Unbound Pocketwatch
free_1h.description: Use: Grants you an Unbound Hour, allowing any activity of your choosing for 1 hour for free.

free_4h.name: Chronicle of the Long Evening
free_4h.description: Use: Grants you 4 Unbound Hours, allowing any activity of your choosing for 4 hours for free.

free_24h.name: Epoch Hourglass of the Unbound Day
free_24h.description:
Use: Shatters the shackles of your routine, granting one full day of any activity for free.

You continue to earn from productive and daily deeds.

profit_24h_5.name: Scroll of Prosperity I
profit_24h_5.description: Use: For 24 hours, gold earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 5%.

profit_24h_10.name: Scroll of Prosperity II
profit_24h_10.description: Use: For 24 hours, gold earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 10%.

profit_24h_20.name: Scroll of Prosperity III
profit_24h_20.description: Use: For 24 hours, gold earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 20%.

xp_24h_3.name: Blessing of Wisdom I
xp_24h_3.description: Use: For 24 hours, XP earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 3%.

xp_24h_7.name: Blessing of Wisdom II
xp_24h_7.description: Use: For 24 hours, XP earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 7%.

xp_24h_15.name: Blessing of Wisdom III
xp_24h_15.description: Use: For 24 hours, XP earned from productive and daily deeds is increased by 15%.

start_40.name: Four of Blessings
start_40.description: Use: Blesses your next productive activity lasting at least 30 minutes to grant 40 bonus gold upon completion.

start_80.name: Eight of Blessings
start_80.description: Use: Blesses your next productive activity lasting at least 1 hour to grant 80 bonus gold upon completion.

start_160.name: Ace of Blessings
start_160.description: Use: Blesses your next productive activity lasting at least 2 hours to grant 160 bonus gold upon completion.

meditate_5min.name: Key to Deep Focus I
meditate_5min.description: Use: Meditate for at least 5 minutes to receive 30 bonus gold.

meditate_10min.name: Key to Deep Focus II
meditate_10min.description: Use: Meditate for at least 10 minutes to receive 50 bonus gold.

meditate_15min.name: Key to Deep Focus III
meditate_15min.description: Use: Meditate for at least 15 minutes to receive 70 bonus gold.

discount_all_15.name: Mystical Orb
discount_all_15.description: Use: For 24 hours, the gold cost of all unproductive activities is reduced by 15%.

discount_all_30.name: Twilight Orb
discount_all_30.description: Use: For 24 hours, the gold cost of all unproductive activities is reduced by 30%.

discount_all_50.name: Orb of Deception
discount_all_50.description: Use: For 24 hours, the gold cost of all unproductive activities is reduced by 50%.
